metadata.project: Click Appeal as a Potential Game: Modeling Creator Incentives, Attention Congestion, and Social Welfare in YouTube
metadata.authors: Bhavya Shah (24110324) - Payoff Estimation | Khushi Shah (24110326) - Game Theory
metadata.calibration_status: Post-Test Final Full-Sample Calibration (N = 809 videos, G = 38 channels)
metadata.locked_specification: Model 4-Centered: Strategic Payoff Function with Contemporaneous Peer Appeal

sample_summary.peer_window_description: Contemporaneous rolling 60-day window [t - 30d, t + 30d], LOCO across channels
sample_summary.subscribers_snapshot_note: Subscriber count measured as late-2026 snapshot; acts as time-invariant channel scale control

locked_centered_coefficients.specification: ln(V_it) = beta_0_c + beta_1_c*(x - mu_x) + beta_2_c*(x - mu_x)^2 + beta_3_c*(x_bar - mu_xbar) + beta_5_c*(x - mu_x)*(x_bar - mu_xbar) + gamma_s*ln(s_i) + gamma_d*ln(dur_it) + gamma_a*age_it + eps_it

uncentered_reference_coefficients.specification: ln(V_it) = beta_0 + beta_1*x_it + beta_2*x_it^2 + beta_3*x_bar_(-i,t) + beta_5*x_it*x_bar_(-i,t) + gamma_s*ln(s_i) + gamma_d*ln(dur_it) + gamma_a*age_it + eps_it
uncentered_reference_coefficients.note_on_equivalence: beta_2 and beta_5 are numerically identical between centered and uncentered models

hypothesis_test_diminishing_returns_conc.interpretation: Concavity is NOT statistically established at alpha=0.05. Point estimate beta_2 < 0 must be treated as calibrated benchmark.

hypothesis_test_strategic_interaction.interpretation: Strategic interaction is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05). Packaging effects carry substantial residual uncertainty.

game_theoretic_properties.exact_potential_function: Phi(x_1, ..., x_N) = sum_i [ beta_1_c*(x_i - mu_x) + beta_2_c*(x_i - mu_x)^2 ] + [beta_5_c / (2*(N-1))] * sum_i sum_{j != i} (x_i - mu_x)*(x_j - mu_xbar) - sum_i C_i(x_i)
game_theoretic_properties.best_response_equation: BR_i(x_{-i}) = argmax_{x_i in [0, 1]} [ ln V_i(x_i, x_bar_{-i}) - C_i(x_i) ]

production_cost_guidance_for_game_theory.boundary_warning: Because empirical beta_2 has high variance, setting kappa_i > 0 guarantees strict game concavity (2*beta_2 - kappa_i < 0) for all creators even in regions where empirical beta_2 fluctuates.
production_cost_guidance_for_game_theory.equilibrium_uniqueness: When 2*|beta_2| + kappa_min > |beta_5|, best-response dynamics form a contraction mapping, guaranteeing a unique pure-strategy Nash Equilibrium.
